body:
Step B4 of the multi-account design (, section 6).

* `ListsRepo.copy(sourceListId, targetAccountId)`: new list under the target with a fresh id,
  fresh field clocks, `updated_by` = this device, items and category order copied, name suffixed
  as today (T-63). Into a server account: rows are dirty and push on the next sync. Into the
  local area: no sync, roster "You".
* List properties → Copy: with one account exactly today's behaviour; with several, a picker
  "Copy to" listing the accounts (the local area included; the source account first). Ledgers
  show the picker with only the source account, plus a one-line reason why they cannot cross
  accounts.
* Hidden fields survive as today (stores, price, quantity on a checklist).
* Strings in nine locales; no web change.
* Tests: copy server → local strips members and never appears in a push; copy local → server
  pushes exactly the copied rows; copying a ledger across accounts is refused in the repo, not
  only hidden in the UI; shared items stay untouched in the source.
title: Android: copy a list into another account or the local area (B4)
